user.title: Select WeekAqua Bluetooth Light
user.description: Choose a discovered WeekAqua device from the list, or select manual entry.

manual.title: Enter WeekAqua MAC Address Manually
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your WeekAqua light (e.g. AA:BB:CC:11:22:33).

bluetooth_confirm.title: Discovered WeekAqua Device
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found WeekAqua device: {name} ({address}). Do you want to add it?

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WeekAqua Device & Model
reconfigure.description:
Current Device: {current_name} ({current_mac}) [{current_model}]
Select a new Bluetooth device or hardware model to reconfigure.

reconfigure_manual.title: Manually Reconfigure WeekAqua MAC & Model
reconfigure_manual.description:
Current Device: {current_name} ({current_mac})
Enter new MAC address and hardware model specification.

error.invalid_mac: Invalid Bluetooth MAC address format (expected e.g. AA:BB:CC:11:22:33).

abort.already_configured: This WeekAqua device MAC is already configured in another entry.
abort.reconfigure_successful: WeekAqua device and model specification successfully reconfigured.
abort.reconfigure_failed: Cannot find the target config entry to reconfigure.
